cp_custom_FpRecSqrtEst_edges.fix: Script used even exponent only (bit10=0). Fixed to use both even/odd exponents.

cp_custom_vfncvt_rod_overflow.fix: Template used get_vr_element_zero() which extracts at output SEW. Fixed to use ins.current.vs2_val[63:0].

cp_custom_FpRecSqrtEst_flag_edges.fix: RVVI fsflagsi alias bug: fsflagsi writes CSR 001 but not CSR 003. Added spacer tests (vfrsqrt7(+inf)) after flag-setting tests to clear stale fcsr.

cp_custom_FpRecipEst_flag_edges.fix: Same RVVI alias bug. Added spacer tests (vfrec7(-inf)) after flag-setting tests to clear stale fcsr.

cp_custom_vfp_state.fix: Added ifdef COVER_VFCUSTOM64 + ifdef XLEN32 guard to template so covergroup is excluded for SEW64 on RV32 (sd/ld needs zilsd). Script sew>xlen guard remains for test generation.

cp_custom_vfredosum_NAN_vl0.fix: Added get_vr_element_zero_widen() to RISCV_coverage_vector.svh (extracts at 2*SEW). Template uses OR of both SEW and 2*SEW checks. Script loads qNaN at 2*SEW for vfwredosum. ifndef COVER_VFCUSTOM64 guards widen block (no SEW128).

cp_custom_vfp_flags.coverage: 30-68% per instruction. Many at 0% (vfclass/vfmerge/vmf*/vfsgnj/vfslide/vfreduce — these are in NO_FLAG_INSTRUCTIONS and won't be covered).
cp_custom_vfp_flags.fix: Two bugs fixed: (1) Template vfsqrt_flag_set was checking ins.current.insn=='vfrsqrt7.v' (always false — insn is 32-bit encoding, not string, and framework already routes per instruction). Fixed to just vs2_val==0. (2) v0_element_1_active bins target={1} was testing active element, but cross tests inactive — fixed to {0}. Script: added double-test pattern for all flag types (NX/NV/DZ/OF/UF) to cover stays-set transition bins (NX1/NV1/DZ1/OF1/UF1). Needs re-run to verify.

cp_custom_fmv_sf_vd_all_lmul.issue: Cross needs 128 bins (32 regs × 4 LMULs) but sail can only handle ~35 tests per file. Individual coverpoints (vd_all_regs, vtype_all_lmul) at 100%. Cross at 27.34%. Needs RTL sim for full coverage.

cp_custom_fmv_fs_vs2_all_lmul.issue: Same cross issue as fmv_sf_vd_all_lmul. Cross 35/128 bins covered. Needs RTL sim.

cp_custom_maskLS.fix: Removed sew>xlen guard. SIGUPD_COUNT=5000 fixes sail timeout.

cp_custom_vwholeRegLS_vill.issue: Coverage framework bug: vill=1 shown in RVVI traces but not reported by coverage tool for EFFEW>8

cp_custom_vwholeRegLS_lmul.fix: Removed sew>xlen guard. SIGUPD_COUNT=5000 fixes sail timeout.
